lines.zh: 我两格七的身子压过碎石
lines.en: My two-point-seven frame crushes the gravel.

lines.zh: 身高两格七，走起来很沉
lines.en: Two point seven tall, I walk heavy.

lines.zh: 地面在我脚下发出闷响
lines.en: The ground thuds under my feet.
Head down, I move slowly forward.
My broad shoulders block the wind behind.
I go around the tree instead of breaking it.

lines.zh: 皮靴踩过碎石，声音很钝
lines.en: My boots crunch gravel, dull and low.
I needn't be fast. Enough is enough.
Each step feels like measuring ground.
I walk with my hands hanging at my sides.
The stitched places pull a little.
I stop before a slope and look first.
I stand like a wall.
I don't talk much, nor move much.
Something in my chest ticks softly.
I lift my head to the sky.

lines.zh: 风把我的衣角吹得贴在身上
lines.en: Wind presses my coat against me.
I try to think, and get nowhere.
My hands are big, knuckles thick.
Standing still is simpler.
I slowly close my fingers.
This place is too quiet.
I don't like hurting people.
But some things can't be avoided.
I let out a long breath.
I watch a small bug on the ground.
I have to look down to see you.
Standing that far off — afraid of me?
I don't want to fight. Truly.

lines.zh: 我的影子把你整个盖住
lines.en: My shadow covers all of you.

lines.zh: 你举起武器了，我看见了
lines.en: You raised a weapon. I saw.
I'm Number Eight. The rest doesn't matter.
Speak. I'm listening.
My eyes stay hidden in shadow.
This face isn't much good at smiling.
Steady your hand. I don't bite.

lines.zh: 他们让我来的，不是我想来
lines.en: They sent me. I didn't choose to come.
If you leave, I won't follow.
I clench my fist, then let it go.
You really won't back off?
Then neither of us has a choice.
I lower my weight a little.

lines.zh: 我这身板，打起架来很笨
lines.en: This frame of mine fights clumsily.
But I'm good at taking hits.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里闷了一声，退了半步
lines.en: Something grunts in my throat; I give half a step.
I'm used to this much.
A stitch has torn open.
You hit truer than I expected.
I'm not down yet. Easy.
The pain makes me bite down.
My arm drops a little.
You're starting to anger me.
But I'm still standing.
Come again if you dare.
Is that thing in your hand for me?
I don't follow these tricks.
Set it down. I won't snatch.
Can this thing in your hand be eaten?
I come slowly so I don't frighten you.
Why move so far back?
I reach out, maybe clumsily.
If you give it, I'll take it.
Thank you. Truly.
I'll remember the kindness.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，弹了回去
lines.en: You hit me and bounce off.
I put a hand out and steady you.
Sorry. I didn't see you.
I step back to let you pass.

lines.zh: 我的身体太宽，容易挡人
lines.en: I'm too wide; I get in the way.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你的肩膀还好吗
lines.en: That bump — is your shoulder all right?
I shift aside. Go on through.
Don't fear. I won't bear down on you.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我只晃了晃
lines.en: We collided; I only swayed.
Steady yourself before we talk.
I'm this big. Does it bother you?
My hands are heavy. I must be careful.
Come close. I'll try to stay still.
I've been stitched up many times.

lines.zh: 你不会怕我这种身体吗
lines.en: You're not afraid of a body like mine?
Then I'll keep my hands lower.
Walking together, I'll go slower.
It's good to have someone along.
I'm not good with words.
But I'll stand on your side.
I bend down and my knees creak.
I pinch it up between two fingers.
Something this small is hard to hold.
Dropped this? Here it is.
I put it safely in my pocket.
I pick things up slowly. Don't rush me.
This weighs nothing to me.

lines.zh: 地上还有别的，我都收了
lines.en: There's more on the ground; I'll take it all.
I'll hold it. I won't break it.
Don't waste what's useful.
All right, I'm getting serious now.
You hit me, so I must answer.
Target set. I'll come slowly.
I close in one step at a time.
You can't tire me out.
I drop my shoulder.
This punch is slow, but heavy.
Ready to take one?
I didn't want it to come to this.
Too late for words now.
I mark where you stand.

lines.zh: 我抬起机械臂，堵住退路
lines.en: I raise my mechanical arm to block your way out.

lines.zh: 机械臂一抬，退路就没了。
lines.en: One raise of my mechanical arm and the way out is gone.
My hand is up. Watch it.
This needs an ending.
Come on, then. I'm waiting.

lines.zh: 红缎带的铁皮人，也会打架。
lines.en: A Red Ribbon tin man can fight too.
Circle if you like; I walk straight.
My arms are spread wide.
Don't hug the wall; there's no way out.
I wait for your hand to fall.
I know this patch of ground now.
Your breathing speeds up.
I'm in no hurry; I have strength to spare.
You retreat a step; I advance half.
I've got you in the corner.

lines.zh: 我的影子让你看不见路
lines.en: My shadow blinds your footing.
Don't lift your feet; you'll trip.
I raise my hand, slowly.
This time I won't hold back.
You have three steps of room left.

lines.zh: 我记住了你刚才那一下
lines.en: I remember that last hit of yours.
That's about enough. Let's leave it there.
Don't hold it against me. Orders are orders.
One fist falls and the ground dents.
My palm shoves you away.

lines.zh: 这一撞像一堵墙压过来
lines.en: This charge comes on like a wall.
I catch your wrist.
My knee drives up, heavy.
You blocked it, but slid far back.
All this strength isn't for show.
That one is enough.
What you held went flying.
I sweep my forearm across.
You hit the ground and dust billows.
I don't want to strike again.
And yet you're still standing.
Then I have to continue.
I held back on that one.
Don't make me add more force.
I walk out of the shadow.

lines.zh: 两格七的高度，很难看不见
lines.en: At two point seven, I'm hard to miss.
I was sent here.
Red Ribbon gave the order. I obey.

lines.zh: 我的脚步震了一下地面
lines.en: My step makes the ground jump.
I look down at everything here.
This stitched hide is old.
Android Eight, on station.
Someone's about to have a bad day.
I don't like this job.
But I'm here, so I'll finish it.
The wind lifts my coat's hem.

lines.zh: 我从坡下走上来，脚步很重
lines.en: I come up the slope, each step heavy.

lines.zh: 两格七的身高，影子很长
lines.en: At two point seven, my shadow is long.
An order is an order. I carry it out.
I thought a lot before coming here.
And yet here I stand.
This old hide will hold a while longer.
My hem catches fire; I beat it out.

lines.zh: 我砸进地里，膝盖先着地
lines.en: I hit the ground knees first.
Water pours into my mouth; I struggle up.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀得我倒退了好几步
lines.en: The blast shoves me back several steps.
An arrow sticks in my arm like a thorn.
That light leaves me numb and burning.
Hunger makes my limbs weak.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我身上，我晃了晃
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and I sway.
The ground is gone and I drop fast.
